TestUserFunctions::test_migration.description: 3-node cluster; creates three Lua UDFs (x_2, x_3, x_4), each via a different node's exclusive session, then asserts all three are usable from every node in one SELECT. Checks type error when passing int column to double UDF, then drops each function via a different node and asserts all nodes reject queries using them. Guards cross-node propagation of UDF schema mutations (create/drop).

TestUserFunctions::test_udf_overload_tes.description: Single node; creates 4 Lua overloads of `overloaded` (varchar, int, text, ascii; varchar==text so 3rd replaces 1st), asserts per-type resolution in SELECT (varchar/text->f3, int->f2, ascii->f4), dropping non-existent overloads fails, DROP without args fails when ambiguous, DROP overloaded(varchar) then overloaded(text) fails as non-existent, finally unambiguous DROP works. Also intended to assert overloaded('foo') literal is ambiguous.

TestUserFunctions::test_udf_overload_tes.reason: Per-arg-type UDF resolution (varchar==text, ascii, int) not directly covered in scylla; DROP parts covered by test_udf.py::test_drop_overloaded_udf. Single-node CQL semantics, easy cqlpy port. Bug: user_functions_test.py:138-142 ambiguity assert is dead - after scylla 9161b7591d the call resolves to overloaded(text) and only the unrelated filtering error is hit (before 896115a900 it hit unknown column k), so 'Ambiguous' is never checked.

TestUserFunctions::test_aggregate_udf.description: Single node; creates Lua UDFs plus(int,int) and stri(int)->text, UDA suma(int) SFUNC plus STYPE int FINALFUNC stri INITCOND 10, asserts suma(val) over 1..3 = '16'.
